about.title: About me
about.body: I work well when the problem is poorly defined and when the code I inherit is not mine. I have led test automation in banking, migrated applications to TypeScript in e-commerce, and built microfrontends in fintech. What stays consistent across those contexts: I read the code before writing my own, I prefer a small reviewable PR over a large explained one, and I review what I ship with the same attention I give to what lands in my queue.
